Date: Thu, 20 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Kickoff: engineer-focused RSVP mini-series + tracking brief

Team —

We need a concise inbound invite cadence for our Sept 14 webinar: "Scaling Inference for Platform Engineers." Goal: drive platform/infra engineers (not just C-suite) to register and show. Ask: build a 3-email mini-series (Invite, Reminder at T-minus 3 days, Last-chance at T-minus 1 day) plus a calendar invite step for registrants. Key constraints:
- Personalize first line by persona (Platform Engineer vs. SRE vs. ML Infra).
- Generate unique tracking tokens per persona + acquisition channel (organic, partner, paid).
- AB test 2 subject lines for the initial invite (role-specific vs. benefit-specific).
- Use Zoom registration link with HubSpot UTM sync.

Deliverables by EOD Aug 26:
1) Email copy for each send (short, engineer tone).
2) Subject line variants (2 per send).
3) Tracking link matrix (CSV) with final tokens.
4) Example preview screenshots for Gmail and Outlook.

I'll attach a rough template for copy. Please flag any blockers — metrics we care about: CTR to registration, registration-to-attend rate, and CPA by persona/channel.

Thanks,
Kimberly
Director, Field Marketing
Redwood Inference

Attachments: invite-email-templates-v2.docx (docx)

Kim / all —

Great brief. Drafting copy now — high level notes and subject line ideas below. I attached the templates with inline variations.

Subject line options (invite):
A1) "How top infra teams cut inference latency — Sept 14"
A2) "Scaling inference: tactics platform engineers actually use"

Quick copy direction (invite):
- Open with a one-line technical hook referencing 'KV cache hits' or 'prefetching for cold-starts' for Platform Engineers.
- Short agenda bullet list (20 min talk + 10 min live Q&A + rollback examples).
- CTA: "Reserve your seat — free" with a single link.

Tracking token suggestion: bit.ly/redwood-eng-{persona}-{chan}-{seq} (e.g. bit.ly/redwood-eng-pe-org-01). HubSpot should ingest the UTM params utm_source=redwood&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=eng-webinar&utm_term={persona}&utm_content={variant}.

Attachments: invite-email-templates-v2.docx (I put the subject variants and 3 copy lengths: 1-line, short, and expanded)

Adding the ops side — delivery windows and reminder cadence:

Send windows (US timezones):
- Primary send: 9:00–10:30am PT (targets Eng managers & ICs).
- Secondary send for EMEA: 10:00–11:30am BST (use local-friendly subject line).

Reminder schedule:
- Reminder 1: T-minus 3 days (short 2-line note + speaker highlight).
- Reminder 2: T-minus 1 day (last chance; emphasize recordings only for registrants).
- Day-of: 1 hour before (calendar + dial-in).

Tracking and attribution: use unique ?reg_token=xxxxx on the Zoom registration and pass that through to HubSpot. My recommended UTM scheme: utm_source=email&utm_medium=engage&utm_campaign=eng-webinar-20260914&utm_term={persona}. I'll attach the tracking-link-matrix.csv with sample tokens (please don't use real prospect emails in tokens).

Also propose a lightweight RSVP nurture: if someone registers but doesn't open any email, push a short SMS reminder (if phone exists) 2 hours before.

Tessa
Marketing Ops

Quick QA & security notes before we finalize tokens:
- Do NOT put identifiable customer or prospect emails inside the public bit.ly tokens. Use opaque tokens that map in our CSV.
- Confirm that the Zoom registration page will accept the reg_token param and persist it to the confirmation email — otherwise we lose attribution on attendance.
- Preview screenshots: attached screenshot-email-preview.png. In Gmail the CTA renders differently on mobile; reduce button padding to avoid truncation.

Also: for partner referrals (Acme Cloud Events), give them a partner-specific token and set partner=acme in the UTM so reporting can attribute pipeline.

Ben
Demand Gen
